seoTitle.en: Mental Age Test: Free 30-Question Classic Quiz
seoTitle.zh: 心理年龄测试：30题经典版与实际年龄对照

description.en: Take the free 30-question mental age test. Reveal your quiz age, style, optional age gap and equivalent year, then preview and save a share card.
description.zh: 免费心理年龄测试：30道偏好题，中文另有3个可跳过资料屏。揭晓娱乐年龄、风格、可选实际年龄差及等效年份，预览保存分享卡。

instructions.en: Choose Agree, Neither or Disagree for thirty statements. Selection advances automatically; Back lets you revise. Actual age is optional and never changes the quiz age. About four minutes is an editorial estimate.
instructions.zh: 三十条陈述各选同意、中立或不同意，选择后自动前进，可返回改选。中文另有三个可跳过非计分屏。实际年龄可保密，不改变娱乐年龄。 约四分钟为编辑估计。

introduction.en: What is my mental age? Answer thirty original preferences, reveal a playful age from 10 to 70 and one of seven styles, then compare it with your actual age if you wish. See the transparent calculation, an equivalent calendar year and a card you can preview before saving or sharing. Free, no signup or birthday. This is entertainment, not a measure of IQ or maturity.
introduction.zh: 我的心理年龄是多少？回答三十道原创偏好题，揭晓10至70的娱乐年龄和七种风格之一，再自愿对照实际年龄。查看透明算式、等效年份，预览后保存或分享卡片。中文共有33个答题屏，其中末尾3屏可跳过且不计分。全部免费，无需账户或生日；仅供娱乐，不衡量智力或成熟度。

resultHeading.zh: 你的经典心理年龄结果

prompt.en: I enjoy picking a small weekend activity at the last minute.
prompt.zh: 周末的小活动，我喜欢临时决定。

prompt.en: Before a busy day, I like knowing the order of my plans.
prompt.zh: 忙碌的一天开始前，我喜欢先确定事情的顺序。

prompt.en: An unfamiliar snack can make an ordinary afternoon more interesting.
prompt.zh: 一种没尝过的小吃能让普通的下午更有趣。

prompt.en: My favorite way to unwind is a routine I already know well.
prompt.zh: 放松时，我最喜欢已经熟悉的固定安排。

prompt.en: When browsing a library, I often follow a topic I did not come for.
prompt.zh: 逛图书馆时，我常会被原本没打算看的话题吸引。

prompt.en: I prefer a small collection of favorites to constantly changing my choices.
prompt.zh: 比起不断换选择，我更喜欢保留一小批心头好。

prompt.en: A playful surprise usually sounds better to me than a detailed preview.
prompt.zh: 一次轻松的惊喜，通常比提前了解全部细节更吸引我。

prompt.en: For a casual gathering, an agreed finishing time helps me enjoy it.
prompt.zh: 轻松聚会时，约好结束时间会让我更享受过程。

prompt.en: I like trying a different way to decorate a familiar space.
prompt.zh: 布置熟悉的空间时，我喜欢试试不同的方式。

prompt.en: A quiet conversation is often my first choice over a lively group activity.
prompt.zh: 安静聊天通常比热闹的集体活动更符合我的心意。

prompt.en: In a harmless creative project, I enjoy experimenting before making a plan.
prompt.zh: 做没有风险的小创作时，我喜欢先试一试，再定计划。

prompt.en: I find it satisfying to finish one leisure project before starting another.
prompt.zh: 先完成一个休闲小项目再开始下一个，会让我感到满足。

prompt.en: A free afternoon feels inviting even when I have no plan for it.
prompt.zh: 空出一个下午，即使没有安排，也让我觉得很期待。

prompt.en: When choosing a walk, I often prefer a route whose details I recognize.
prompt.zh: 选散步路线时，我往往更喜欢细节熟悉的那条。

prompt.en: I enjoy discovering a new musician without checking whether the style suits me.
prompt.zh: 发现新音乐人时，我愿意先听听，不急着确认风格是否适合。

prompt.en: I like having a familiar place I can return to again and again.
prompt.zh: 我喜欢拥有一个可以反复回访的熟悉地方。

prompt.en: A friendly invitation to try an unfamiliar game can quickly catch my interest.
prompt.zh: 有人友好地邀请我玩陌生小游戏，很容易引起我的兴趣。

prompt.en: For optional outings, I prefer deciding the practical details in advance.
prompt.zh: 安排自愿参加的出游时，我喜欢提前定好实际细节。

prompt.en: Changing one small part of my day often feels refreshing.
prompt.zh: 改变一天中的一个小细节，常让我觉得耳目一新。

prompt.en: I enjoy the anticipation of a regular weekly ritual.
prompt.zh: 想到每周固定的小仪式，我就会感到期待。

prompt.en: If two free activities are equally accessible, I am drawn to the unfamiliar one.
prompt.zh: 两项免费活动同样方便参加时，陌生的那项更吸引我。

prompt.en: I prefer a comfortable pace with time to notice details.
prompt.zh: 我更喜欢舒适的节奏，留出时间留意细节。

prompt.en: I enjoy an open-ended conversation that moves between unexpected topics.
prompt.zh: 我喜欢话题会意外转弯、没有预定方向的聊天。

prompt.en: I often choose to revisit a book, film or game I already appreciate.
prompt.zh: 我常会选择重温已经喜欢的书、电影或游戏。

prompt.en: Trying a new hobby briefly can be enjoyable even if I never continue it.
prompt.zh: 即使以后不继续，短暂尝试一种新爱好也可能让我开心。

prompt.en: I value leaving enough space between plans rather than fitting in more activities.
prompt.zh: 我重视给安排之间留出空当，而不是塞进更多活动。

prompt.en: For a low-stakes choice, I am happy to discover the details as I go.
prompt.zh: 做一项影响不大的选择时，我乐意边进行边了解细节。

prompt.en: Keeping a familiar setup often helps me settle into an enjoyable activity.
prompt.zh: 保持熟悉的环境布置，常能帮我安心享受活动。

prompt.en: An unexpected change to a relaxed plan can feel like part of the fun.
prompt.zh: 轻松计划中出现意外变化，也可能是乐趣的一部分。

prompt.en: When I have free choice, a settled and predictable evening often appeals to me.
prompt.zh: 可以自由选择时，安稳且有预期的夜晚常常很吸引我。

title.en: Mental Age Test Results: Age, Styles & Calculation
title.zh: 心理年龄测试结果：年龄、风格与计算方法

summary.en: Thirty preferences, seven original styles, an optional age comparison and an equivalent year.
summary.zh: 三十项偏好、七个原创风格、可选实际年龄对照与等效年份。

scoreReading.en: Quiz age = 10 + the sum of thirty 0–2 point choices.
scoreReading.zh: 娱乐年龄＝10＋三十题0至2点之和。

title.en: Mental Age Test Results: Styles, Age Gap & Scoring
title.zh: 心理年龄测试结果：风格、年龄差与评分规则

description.en: Understand the 30-question classic quiz, seven styles, optional actual-age comparison and equivalent year. See the full scoring and privacy rules.
description.zh: 看懂30题经典版、七个风格、可选实际年龄对照及等效年份，查看完整评分、中文33屏用途和隐私说明。

paragraphs.en: Your quiz age summarizes thirty preferences using a game rule. It is not your actual mental age, an IQ result, a maturity grade or a clinical assessment. The seven style names describe regions of this quiz’s scale, not kinds of people. Read your number alongside the situations you imagined.
paragraphs.zh: 娱乐年龄用一条游戏规则概括三十项偏好，不是真实心智年龄、智商、成熟度等级或临床评估。七个风格名称描述本游戏数轴上的区域，不是七类人。请结合自己想象的具体情境来读数字。

paragraphs.en: Each statement has Agree, Neither and Disagree choices worth 0, 1 or 2 points. Fifteen statements give Agree zero points; the other fifteen give Agree two. The middle choice always gives one. Add thirty values as S, from 0 to 60: quiz age = 10 + S. Every integer from 10 through 70 is reachable. No gender, feedback, astrology choice or actual age changes this number.
paragraphs.zh: 每条陈述提供同意、中立、不同意三项，计0、1或2点。其中十五题同意计0点，另十五题同意计2点，中立始终计1点。三十题相加为S，范围0至60；娱乐年龄＝10＋S，可得到10至70的每个整数。性别、体验感受、星座看法及实际年龄均不改变这个数字。

paragraphs.en: Thirty middle answers give S = 30 and age 40. Choosing every zero-point option gives 10; every two-point option gives 70. Choosing Agree throughout also gives 40 because the two key directions balance. Changing one choice from zero to two adds two displayed years. That is arithmetic, not two years of development.
paragraphs.zh: 三十题全选中立，S＝30、年龄40；全选0点项得到10，全选2点项得到70。全部同意也会得到40，因为两种计分方向恰好各占一半。单题从0改成2，会让显示年龄增加2，这只是算术变化，不是两年的心理发展。

paragraphs.en: The ranges are 10–18 Discovery spark, 19–27 Playful explorer, 28–36 Curious mixer, 37–43 Open blend, 44–52 Familiar anchor, 53–61 Quiet rhythm, and 62–70 Steady ritual. These editorial ranges are disclosed for reading the game. They have no population norms or developmental meaning. Higher and lower are not better or worse.
paragraphs.zh: 10—18为发现火花，19—27为轻快探索，28—36为好奇混搭，37—43为随心调和，44—52为熟悉锚点，53—61为安静节奏，62—70为稳定仪式。这些公开分段是游戏读法，没有人群常模或发展意义，高低不代表优劣。

title.en: Actual age and an equivalent year

paragraphs.en: Actual age is optional: enter an integer from 1 to 125 or keep it private. The comparison is quiz age minus actual age; it does not diagnose being ahead or behind. The equivalent year is the current UTC calendar year minus your quiz age, without using a birthday. It is a fictional calendar comparison, not your birth year. For 2026 and quiz age 40, it is 1986.
paragraphs.zh: 实际年龄可填1至125的整数，也可以保密。差值＝娱乐年龄－实际年龄，不诊断发展超前或落后。等效年份＝当前UTC公历年份－娱乐年龄，不使用生日；它是虚构的日历类比，不是你的出生年份。例如2026年得到40，等效年份为1986。

paragraphs.en: English has thirty scored preference screens. Chinese has the same thirty scored statements followed by three optional, unscored screens: gender information, this session’s experience and a view on astrology. Each can be skipped. Their values remain in page memory only, are not sent as feedback and are not used for the age, style or card. The optional actual-age setup is outside these screen counts.
paragraphs.zh: 英文包含三十个计分偏好屏。中文在同样三十题后，加上性别信息、本次体验感受、星座看法三个可跳过的非计分屏。它们仅停留在本页内存，不作为反馈发送，不参与年龄、风格或卡片。可选实际年龄设置不计入上述答题屏数。

paragraphs.en: Preview your card before choosing a 1200 × 630 landscape or 1080 × 1920 portrait PNG. Cards are created in your browser. Actual age and the gap are excluded unless you select their inclusion. A system share can be canceled; unsupported or denied sharing leaves a downloadable preview. Copy public entry contains only the title and public link, never the number, age, answers or optional information.
paragraphs.zh: 先预览卡片，再选择保存1200×630横版或1080×1920竖版PNG。图片在浏览器生成，实际年龄和差值默认不包含，勾选后才加入。系统分享可取消；不支持或被拒绝时仍可保存预览。复制公开入口仅包含标题和公开链接，不含数字、实际年龄、答案或附加资料。

paragraphs.en: No account or birthday is required. This edition keeps answers, actual age and optional information in this page’s memory and does not store a resumable draft. Leaving or retaking clears the attempt; previous-edition drafts are discarded rather than padded into thirty answers. Result language can change locally without putting data in a URL. All items, labels and explanations are original FermatMind editorial content; no reliability, age calibration or cross-language measurement equivalence has been established. This edition uses FermatMind’s original statements, labels and disclosed game rules. A similar classic flow does not guarantee identical question banks, scoring or results to another website; it does not reproduce an undisclosed algorithm.
paragraphs.zh: 无需账户或生日。本版把答案、实际年龄和附加资料保留在本页内存，不保存可恢复草稿；退出或重测即清除。旧版草稿会失效清除，不会补成三十题。结果语言可在本页切换，数据不进入URL。题目、风格及解释由费马原创编辑，尚未建立信度、年龄校准或跨语言测量等值。 本版采用费马原创题文、标签和公开游戏规则。经典流程相似不代表与其他网站的题本、计分或结果相同，也不复现未公开算法。
